section: Union Public Service Commission and State Public Service Commissions - composition, functions, removal
subsections: Committees reviewing the civil services examination

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II regarding committees that reviewed the Civil Services Examination:

List-I (Committee)
a. D.S. Kothari Committee
b. Satish Chandra Committee
c. Y.K. Alagh Committee
d. P.C. Hota Committee

List-II (Theme)
i. Civil service reforms
ii. Review of the Kothari scheme and introduction of an essay paper
iii. Review of the Civil Services Examination system
iv. Introduction of the three-stage examination system

Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
accepted.x: The D.S. Kothari Committee was associated with the three-stage examination system; Satish Chandra reviewed that scheme and introduced the essay paper; Y.K. Alagh reviewed the CSE system; and P.C. Hota dealt with civil service reforms.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair and eliminate codes with swapped committee themes.
accepted.sec: Committees reviewing the civil services examination  [other exams, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following committees:
1. D.S. Kothari Committee
2. Satish Chandra Committee
3. Y.K. Alagh Committee
4. P.C. Hota Committee
5. B.S. Baswan Committee

Which one of the following represents the correct chronological order of their constitution?
accepted.x: The committees belong respectively to 1974–76, 1989, 2000–01, 2004 and 2016, giving the order D.S. Kothari, Satish Chandra, Y.K. Alagh, P.C. Hota and B.S. Baswan.
accepted.tq: Use the earliest and latest years first, then place the middle committees by date.
accepted.sec: Committees reviewing the civil services examination  [other exams, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The three-stage Civil Services Examination consisting of Preliminary Examination, Main Examination and Interview was introduced from:
accepted.x: The three-stage examination system recommended by the D.S. Kothari Committee came into effect from 1979.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the committee-review period from the year in which its recommended pattern began.
accepted.sec: Committees reviewing the civil services examination  [other exams, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The Satish Chandra Committee is associated with which one of the following recommendations or developments?
o: Civil service reforms relating to administrative restructuring
Review of age limit, number of attempts and examination pattern
Review of the Kothari scheme and introduction of an essay paper
Introduction of the three-stage examination system from 1979
accepted.x: The Satish Chandra Committee, constituted in 1989, reviewed the Kothari scheme and was associated with the essay paper.
accepted.tq: Apply the wrong-committee trap by matching each committee with its specific theme.
accepted.sec: Committees reviewing the civil services examination  [other exams, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following committees was associated with civil service reforms?
accepted.x: The P.C. Hota Committee, constituted in 2004, dealt with civil service reforms.
accepted.tq: Test the committee-theme association rather than relying only on chronological recall.
accepted.sec: Committees reviewing the civil services examination  [other exams, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The B.S. Baswan Committee, constituted in 2016, examined issues relating to:
o: The introduction of the essay paper alone
Age limit, number of attempts and examination pattern
The three-stage examination system introduced in 1979
accepted.x: The B.S. Baswan Committee examined the age limit, number of attempts and examination pattern for the Civil Services Examination.
accepted.tq: Beware of the word “only” and identify the option that captures all the stated areas of review.
accepted.sec: Committees reviewing the civil services examination  [other exams, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
With reference to the committees reviewing the Civil Services Examination, consider the following statements:
1. The Y.K. Alagh Committee was constituted during 2000–01.
2. The P.C. Hota Committee was constituted in 2004.
3. The B.S. Baswan Committee was constituted in 2016.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: Y.K. Alagh was associated with 2000–01, P.C. Hota with 2004 and B.S. Baswan with 2016.
accepted.tq: Check each year independently before selecting the cumulative code.
accepted.sec: Committees reviewing the civil services examination  [other exams, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the present concerns associated with State Public Service Commissions:
1. Paper leaks have affected public confidence.
2. Flawed evaluation has led to disputes.
3. Delays and litigation have emerged as significant concerns.
4. Telangana examinations in 2023 and Bihar examinations in 2024 are cited in this context.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Paper leaks, flawed evaluation, delays and litigation are identified as major concerns, with the Telangana 2023 and Bihar 2024 examinations cited as examples.
accepted.tq: Treat the examples in the final statement as factual anchors and verify the broader concerns around them.

accepted.s: The Supreme Court stressed the importance of Public Service Commission independence in which of the following cases?
accepted.x: In T.N. PSC v. A. Balasubramaniam (1994), the Supreme Court stressed that PSC independence is essential for fair administration.
accepted.tq: Discriminate carefully among the case name, year and institution instead of accepting a familiar-looking combination.

accepted.s:
Assertion (A): Independence of Public Service Commissions is essential for fair administration.
Reason (R): Public Service Commissions are intended to safeguard merit in public recruitment and administration.

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
accepted.x: Both statements are true, and the merit-protection role of Public Service Commissions explains why their institutional independence is essential for fair administration.
accepted.tq: Test whether the Reason explains the institutional purpose stated in the Assertion.

accepted.s: Who was the first Indian to clear the Indian Civil Service examination?
accepted.x: Satyendranath Tagore was the first Indian to clear the Indian Civil Service examination, in 1864.
accepted.tq: Use the first-person-in-history cue and avoid confusing it with later examination reform committees.

accepted.s: The simultaneous conduct of the Indian Civil Service examinations in India began in 1922 at:
accepted.x: From 1922, the Indian Civil Service examinations were conducted simultaneously in India at Allahabad.
accepted.tq: Separate the starting year from the examination venue and identify the precise location.
